item.title: Legacy Standard Bible, A Faithful and Precise Translation with Justin Peters
item.description: In this episode of Sound Theology & Discernment, Justin Peters discusses the Legacy Standard Bible and its commitment to faithful, precise translation. This conversation explores the origins of the LSB, its formal equivalence philosophy, and why accuracy, consistency, and transparency to the original biblical languages matter for preaching and teaching.

item.title: Esther 8, Deliverance Decreed
